examples.hanzi: 他靠诚实赢得了好名声。
examples.pinyin: Tā kào chéngshí yíngdé le hǎo míngshēng.
examples.english: He earned a good reputation through honesty.

examples.hanzi: 这位医生在当地很有名声。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yīshēng zài dāngdì hěn yǒu míngshēng.
examples.english: This doctor has a great reputation locally.

examples.hanzi: 学校今天发布了新的通知。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào jīntiān fābù le xīn de tōngzhī.
examples.english: The school issued a new notice today.

examples.hanzi: 这款手机什么时候发布？
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn shǒujī shénme shíhou fābù?
examples.english: When will this phone be released?

examples.hanzi: 他不但英俊，而且很有礼貌。
examples.pinyin: Tā búdàn yīngjùn, érqiě hěn yǒu lǐmào.
examples.english: He is not only handsome but also very polite.

examples.hanzi: 那位英俊的演员走进了餐厅。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi yīngjùn de yǎnyuán zǒujìn le cāntīng.
examples.english: That handsome actor walked into the restaurant.

examples.hanzi: 我们的工作室周末也开门。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de gōngzuòshì zhōumò yě kāimén.
examples.english: Our studio is open on weekends too.

examples.hanzi: 他在音乐工作室录了一首新歌。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yīnyuè gōngzuòshì lù le yì shǒu xīn gē.
examples.english: He recorded a new song at a music studio.

examples.hanzi: 这块木头太重了，我搬不动。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài mùtou tài zhòng le, wǒ bān bu dòng.
examples.english: This piece of wood is too heavy, and I can't move it.

examples.hanzi: 别像木头一样站着，快来帮忙！
examples.pinyin: Bié xiàng mùtou yíyàng zhànzhe, kuài lái bāngmáng!
examples.english: Don't just stand there like a block of wood, come and help!

examples.hanzi: 我们的预算不够买新车。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de yùsuàn bú gòu mǎi xīn chē.
examples.english: Our budget isn't enough to buy a new car.

examples.hanzi: 装修之前最好先做个预算。
examples.pinyin: Zhuāngxiū zhīqián zuìhǎo xiān zuò ge yùsuàn.
examples.english: It's best to make a budget before renovating.

examples.hanzi: 天气预报说会下雨，果然下了。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì yùbào shuō huì xiàyǔ, guǒrán xià le.
examples.english: The forecast said it would rain, and sure enough it did.

examples.hanzi: 你果然没有骗我。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ guǒrán méiyǒu piàn wǒ.
examples.english: As expected, you didn't lie to me.

examples.hanzi: 请把你的账户锁定，以免被盗。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ nǐ de zhànghù suǒdìng, yǐmiǎn bèi dào.
examples.english: Please lock your account to keep it from being stolen.

examples.hanzi: 警察已经锁定了嫌疑人的位置。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá yǐjīng suǒdìng le xiányírén de wèizhi.
examples.english: The police have locked on to the suspect's location.

examples.hanzi: 这张图片是在哪儿拍的？
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng túpiàn shì zài nǎr pāi de?
examples.english: Where was this picture taken?

examples.hanzi: 请上传一张清晰的图片。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng shàngchuán yì zhāng qīngxī de túpiàn.
examples.english: Please upload a clear picture.

examples.hanzi: 首席执行官在会上发了言。
examples.pinyin: Shǒuxí zhíxíngguān zài huì shàng fā le yán.
examples.english: The chief executive spoke at the meeting.

examples.hanzi: 他担任乐团的首席小提琴手。
examples.pinyin: Tā dānrèn yuètuán de shǒuxí xiǎotíqín shǒu.
examples.english: He serves as the orchestra's principal violinist.

examples.hanzi: 比赛成绩将在明天公布。
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài chéngjì jiāng zài míngtiān gōngbù.
examples.english: The match results will be announced tomorrow.

examples.hanzi: 老师还没有公布考试的日期。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī hái méiyǒu gōngbù kǎoshì de rìqī.
examples.english: The teacher hasn't announced the exam date yet.

examples.hanzi: 这位患者需要住院观察。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi huànzhě xūyào zhùyuàn guānchá.
examples.english: This patient needs to stay in the hospital for observation.

examples.hanzi: 医生耐心地给患者解释病情。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng nàixīn de gěi huànzhě jiěshì bìngqíng.
examples.english: The doctor patiently explained the condition to the patient.

examples.hanzi: 我希望余生都能和你在一起。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng yúshēng dōu néng hé nǐ zài yìqǐ.
examples.english: I hope to spend the rest of my life with you.

examples.hanzi: 他把余生都献给了教育事业。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ yúshēng dōu xiàn gěi le jiàoyù shìyè.
examples.english: He devoted the rest of his life to education.

examples.hanzi: 进来之前请先敲门。
examples.pinyin: Jìnlái zhīqián qǐng xiān qiāomén.
examples.english: Please knock on the door before coming in.

examples.hanzi: 他敲门敲了好几次，没人回答。
examples.pinyin: Tā qiāomén qiāo le hǎo jǐ cì, méi rén huídá.
examples.english: He knocked on the door several times, but nobody answered.

examples.hanzi: 新年快乐！祝你身体健康。
examples.pinyin: Xīnnián kuàilè! Zhù nǐ shēntǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: Happy New Year! Wishing you good health.

examples.hanzi: 新年到了，家家户户都贴春联。
examples.pinyin: Xīnnián dào le, jiājiāhùhù dōu tiē chūnlián.
examples.english: The New Year has arrived, and every household puts up spring couplets.

examples.hanzi: 吃太多糖会引发很多健康问题。
examples.pinyin: Chī tài duō táng huì yǐnfā hěn duō jiànkāng wèntí.
examples.english: Eating too much sugar can cause many health problems.

examples.hanzi: 一句玩笑话引发了大家的笑声。
examples.pinyin: Yí jù wánxiào huà yǐnfā le dàjiā de xiàoshēng.
examples.english: A joke set off laughter from everyone.

examples.hanzi: 大树的阴影挡住了阳光。
examples.pinyin: Dà shù de yīnyǐng dǎngzhù le yángguāng.
examples.english: The shadow of the big tree blocked the sunlight.

examples.hanzi: 考试失败后，他走出了阴影。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì shībài hòu, tā zǒuchū le yīnyǐng.
examples.english: After failing the exam, he moved past the shadow it cast.

examples.hanzi: 周末我想去看一部新影片。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ xiǎng qù kàn yí bù xīn yǐngpiàn.
examples.english: This weekend I want to see a new film.

examples.hanzi: 这部影片讲的是一个家庭的故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù yǐngpiàn jiǎng de shì yí ge jiātíng de gùshi.
examples.english: This film tells the story of a family.

examples.hanzi: 他是我们公司的电脑高手。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì wǒmen gōngsī de diànnǎo gāoshǒu.
examples.english: He is the computer expert at our company.

examples.hanzi: 民间有很多隐藏的高手。
examples.pinyin: Mínjiān yǒu hěn duō yǐncáng de gāoshǒu.
examples.english: There are many hidden masters among ordinary people.

examples.hanzi: 我爷爷出生在一个小村子里。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yéye chūshēng zài yí ge xiǎo cūnzi lǐ.
examples.english: My grandfather was born in a small village.

examples.hanzi: 村子后面有一条清澈的小河。
examples.pinyin: Cūnzi hòumiàn yǒu yì tiáo qīngchè de xiǎohé.
examples.english: Behind the village there is a clear little stream.

examples.hanzi: 生活中有酸甜苦辣各种滋味。
examples.pinyin: Shēnghuó zhōng yǒu suān tián kǔ là gèzhǒng zīwèi.
examples.english: Life has all kinds of flavors, sour, sweet, bitter and spicy.

examples.hanzi: 离开家的滋味并不好受。
examples.pinyin: Líkāi jiā de zīwèi bìng bù hǎoshòu.
examples.english: Leaving home is not a pleasant feeling.

examples.hanzi: 这位老师的教学手法很灵活。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī de jiàoxué shǒufǎ hěn línghuó.
examples.english: This teacher's teaching methods are very flexible.

examples.hanzi: 骗子用同样的手法骗了很多人。
examples.pinyin: Piànzi yòng tóngyàng de shǒufǎ piàn le hěn duō rén.
examples.english: The con artist used the same trick to fool many people.

examples.hanzi: 请举起你的右手。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng jǔqǐ nǐ de yòushǒu.
examples.english: Please raise your right hand.

examples.hanzi: 他的右手受伤了，不能写字。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yòushǒu shòushāng le, bù néng xiězì.
examples.english: His right hand is injured, so he can't write.

examples.hanzi: 我想去海边看看辽阔的海洋。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù hǎibiān kànkan liáokuò de hǎiyáng.
examples.english: I'd like to go to the seaside and see the vast ocean.

examples.hanzi: 海洋里生活着很多神奇的动物。
examples.pinyin: Hǎiyáng lǐ shēnghuózhe hěn duō shénqí de dòngwù.
examples.english: Many amazing animals live in the ocean.

examples.hanzi: 霍华德每天骑自行车上班。
examples.pinyin: Huòhuádé měi tiān qí zìxíngchē shàngbān.
examples.english: Howard rides a bike to work every day.

examples.hanzi: 你认识霍华德吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ rènshi Huòhuádé ma?
examples.english: Do you know Howard?

examples.hanzi: 你有什么业余爱好？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shénme yèyú àihào?
examples.english: What hobbies do you have in your spare time?

examples.hanzi: 我爱好摄影，经常去郊外拍照。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ àihào shèyǐng, jīngcháng qù jiāowài pāizhào.
examples.english: I'm fond of photography and often go to the countryside to take photos.

examples.hanzi: 他是个乐观的人，总是笑着面对问题。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì ge lèguān de rén, zǒngshì xiàozhe miànduì wèntí.
examples.english: He is an optimistic person who always faces problems with a smile.

examples.hanzi: 医生对她的恢复情况很乐观。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng duì tā de huīfù qíngkuàng hěn lèguān.
examples.english: The doctor is optimistic about her recovery.

examples.hanzi: 这次意外给孩子带来了心理创伤。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì yìwài gěi háizi dàilái le xīnlǐ chuāngshāng.
examples.english: The accident left the child with psychological trauma.

examples.hanzi: 医生正在处理他腿上的创伤。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng zhèngzài chǔlǐ tā tuǐ shàng de chuāngshāng.
examples.english: The doctor is treating the wound on his leg.

examples.hanzi: 我们至今还保持着联系。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhìjīn hái bǎochí zhe liánxì.
examples.english: We still keep in touch to this day.

examples.hanzi: 至今为止，他一次也没迟到过。
examples.pinyin: Zhìjīn wéizhǐ, tā yí cì yě méi chídào guo.
examples.english: So far, he has never once been late.

examples.hanzi: 请大家预备好笔和纸。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā yùbèi hǎo bǐ hé zhǐ.
examples.english: Everyone, please get your pens and paper ready.

examples.hanzi: 晚饭已经预备好了。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnfàn yǐjīng yùbèi hǎo le.
examples.english: Dinner is already prepared.

examples.hanzi: 吸烟会损伤肺部。
examples.pinyin: Xīyān huì sǔnshāng fèibù.
examples.english: Smoking damages the lungs.

examples.hanzi: 这次摔倒没有损伤他的骨头。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shuāidǎo méiyǒu sǔnshāng tā de gǔtou.
examples.english: This fall didn't injure his bones.

examples.hanzi: 学生考试时不能作弊。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng kǎoshì shí bù néng zuòbì.
examples.english: Students must not cheat during exams.

examples.hanzi: 他因为作弊被老师发现了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi zuòbì bèi lǎoshī fāxiàn le.
examples.english: He was caught cheating by the teacher.

examples.hanzi: 这份报告涉及很多专业知识。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào shèjí hěn duō zhuānyè zhīshi.
examples.english: This report involves a lot of specialized knowledge.

examples.hanzi: 我不想涉及私人问题。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng shèjí sīrén wèntí.
examples.english: I don't want to touch on personal matters.

examples.hanzi: 这部电影征服了全世界的观众。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng zhēngfú le quán shìjiè de guānzhòng.
examples.english: This movie won over audiences around the world.

examples.hanzi: 他想用实力征服评委。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng yòng shílì zhēngfú píngwěi.
examples.english: He wants to win over the judges with his ability.

examples.hanzi: 河边有一间白色的小屋。
examples.pinyin: Hébiān yǒu yì jiān báisè de xiǎowū.
examples.english: There is a little white cabin by the river.

examples.hanzi: 我们在山上的小屋里过了一夜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài shān shàng de xiǎowū lǐ guò le yí yè.
examples.english: We spent a night in a small cabin on the mountain.

examples.hanzi: 罗杰明天要来我们家吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Luójié míngtiān yào lái wǒmen jiā chīfàn.
examples.english: Roger is coming to our house for dinner tomorrow.

examples.hanzi: 这是罗杰送给我的书。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì Luójié sòng gěi wǒ de shū.
examples.english: This is a book Roger gave me.

examples.hanzi: 我们刚搬进新家，还没整理好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gāng bānjìn xīn jiā, hái méi zhěnglǐ hǎo.
examples.english: We just moved into our new home and haven't unpacked yet.

examples.hanzi: 新同事已经搬进了隔壁的办公室。
examples.pinyin: Xīn tóngshì yǐjīng bānjìn le gébì de bàngōngshì.
examples.english: The new colleague has moved into the office next door.

examples.hanzi: 他在警察面前认罪了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài jǐngchá miànqián rènzuì le.
examples.english: He pleaded guilty in front of the police.

examples.hanzi: 只有认罪，才能得到宽大处理。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu rènzuì, cáinéng dédào kuāndà chǔlǐ.
examples.english: Only by admitting guilt can one receive leniency.

examples.hanzi: 邻居们对新搬来的人很友善。
examples.pinyin: Línjūmen duì xīn bān lái de rén hěn yǒushàn.
examples.english: The neighbors are very friendly to the newcomers.

examples.hanzi: 他友善地向我们挥了挥手。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒushàn de xiàng wǒmen huī le huī shǒu.
examples.english: He waved to us in a friendly way.

examples.hanzi: 人们称之为“春运”。
examples.pinyin: Rénmen chēng zhī wéi “chūnyùn”.
examples.english: People call it the “spring travel rush”.

examples.hanzi: 这种现象，科学家称之为全球变暖。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xiànxiàng, kēxuéjiā chēng zhī wéi quánqiú biànnuǎn.
examples.english: Scientists call this phenomenon global warming.

examples.hanzi: 她骨折了，要在家休息两个月。
examples.pinyin: Tā gǔzhé le, yào zài jiā xiūxi liǎng ge yuè.
examples.english: She broke a bone and has to rest at home for two months.

examples.hanzi: 这次骨折让他不能踢球了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì gǔzhé ràng tā bù néng tī qiú le.
examples.english: This fracture means he can't play soccer.

examples.hanzi: 他发誓要为朋友报仇。
examples.pinyin: Tā fāshì yào wèi péngyou bàochóu.
examples.english: He swore to take revenge for his friend.

examples.hanzi: 电影里的主角一心想报仇。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng lǐ de zhǔjué yìxīn xiǎng bàochóu.
examples.english: The hero in the movie is set on revenge.

examples.hanzi: 蝙蝠白天睡觉，晚上出来活动。
examples.pinyin: Biānfú báitiān shuìjiào, wǎnshang chūlái huódòng.
examples.english: Bats sleep during the day and come out at night.

examples.hanzi: 山洞里住着很多蝙蝠。
examples.pinyin: Shāndòng lǐ zhùzhe hěn duō biānfú.
examples.english: Many bats live in the cave.

examples.hanzi: 春节的时候，全家都会聚在一起。
examples.pinyin: Chūnjié de shíhou, quánjiā dōu huì jù zài yìqǐ.
examples.english: At Spring Festival, the whole family gets together.

examples.hanzi: 我们全家都喜欢吃辣的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen quánjiā dōu xǐhuan chī là de.
examples.english: My whole family likes spicy food.

examples.hanzi: 春天的公园里到处是花。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān de gōngyuán lǐ dàochù shì huā.
examples.english: The park is full of flowers in spring.

examples.hanzi: 我最喜欢春天的天气。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan chūntiān de tiānqì.
examples.english: I like spring weather the best.

examples.hanzi: 他淋了雨，浑身都湿透了。
examples.pinyin: Tā lín le yǔ, húnshēn dōu shītòu le.
examples.english: He got caught in the rain and was soaked all over.

examples.hanzi: 我浑身没力气，想早点睡觉。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ húnshēn méi lìqi, xiǎng zǎodiǎn shuìjiào.
examples.english: I have no strength in my whole body and want to go to bed early.

examples.hanzi: 对不起，打搅一下，请问洗手间在哪儿？
examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, dǎjiǎo yíxià, qǐngwèn xǐshǒujiān zài nǎr?
examples.english: Excuse me for interrupting, where is the restroom?

examples.hanzi: 他在睡觉，请不要打搅他。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài shuìjiào, qǐng bú yào dǎjiǎo tā.
examples.english: He is sleeping, so please don't disturb him.

examples.hanzi: 小狗很亲近主人。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎogǒu hěn qīnjìn zhǔrén.
examples.english: The puppy is very close to its owner.

examples.hanzi: 我们是亲近的朋友，什么都可以说。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen shì qīnjìn de péngyou, shénme dōu kěyǐ shuō.
examples.english: We are close friends and can talk about anything.

examples.hanzi: 大家对这个计划没有争论。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā duì zhège jìhuà méiyǒu zhēnglùn.
examples.english: Nobody argued about this plan.

examples.hanzi: 别为这点小事争论了。
examples.pinyin: Bié wèi zhè diǎn xiǎoshì zhēnglùn le.
examples.english: Stop arguing over such a small matter.

examples.hanzi: 今天来听课的人数不多。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān lái tīngkè de rénshù bù duō.
examples.english: Not many people came to the lecture today.

examples.hanzi: 请告诉我你们班的人数。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gàosu wǒ nǐmen bān de rénshù.
examples.english: Please tell me how many people are in your class.
